issues.description: Constructor parameter type for Developer is inconsistent between artifacts: the problem statement and the template expect monthsOfSwiftExperience to be optional (Int?), but the Solution's Developer initializer declares monthsOfSwiftExperience as non-optional (Int). The Solution's Client calls Developer(name: ..., monthsOfSwiftExperience: nil), which does not match the non-optional initializer and would not compile. This is a structural contradiction (constructor signature mismatch) that will confuse students and break the provided solution example.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Solution's Developer initializer accept an optional Int to match the problem statement and template. Change the initializer signature in solution_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift to init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) and assign self.monthsOfSwiftExperience = monthsOfSwiftExperience. This will match Client usage (passing nil) and align all artifacts.
